thread:
Nina: Quick heads-up: scheduled deploy tonight 21:30-22:30 UTC for recommendation-service. We'll pin recommendation-service to v1.7 during the tokenizer swap (avoid mismatched vocab). rolling plan for the new 'rec-safety' flag included below.

Priya: thanks. strong preference for conservative ramp — ranking changes hit core metrics fast.

Omar: suggested ramp: 0.2% -> 1% -> 8% -> 40% -> 100%. soaks: 10m, 15m, 20m, 30m respectively. manual approval at each step.

Jordan: define rollback triggers now:
- synthetic error rate > 2% sustained for 4m
- p95 latency +30% vs baseline for 10m
- prec@10 (canary) drops > 2.5% vs control for 20m
- any GPU OOMs or restart storms
Ops manual pause should immediately freeze the rollout.

Nina: added quality gate: run eval harness on canary traffic every step. if eval delta > 2% we abort. qa-bot will post results.

Priya: release note snippet: "recommendation-service pinned to v1.7 during tokenizer_swap; rec-safety flag will be rolled via staged canary. Ramp owner: @Priya; Abort owner: @Jordan. Rollback triggers listed in thread."

Omar: pin command: ```/deploy pin service:recommendation-service version:v1.7 --until=2026-03-27T23:30Z --reason="tokenizer_swap"```

deploy-bot: pin request accepted, job 72100. targets: prod-us, prod-eu. applied -> pinned. canary slice id: 72100-C. :white_check_mark:

Priya: schedule: start ramp 21:35 UTC at 0.2%. I'll OTP :+1: for each step. add header `X-Canary-Job:72100` and `X-Safety-Flag:rec-safety` to canary requests.

Jordan: automation snippet: ```if synth_err_4m > 0.02 or p95>baseline*1.3 or prec10_drop_20m>0.025: post('#eng-oncall','halt ramp job 72100'); halt_ramp(72100)```

qa-bot: will run eval-suite on canary traffic after each step and post results to thread. threshold: eval_delta > 2% -> FAIL.

ops-bot: canary dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/canary/72100. alert hooks wired to #eng-oncall and SMS for on-call.

Nina: sticky QA cohort: internal-staff group (~5k users) pinned at 5% to run manual verification for heuristics. do not unpin until tokenizer swap confirmed + 90m stable.

Omar: note for unpin: after swap completes, keep pin 1 hour post-swap, then `/deploy unpin service:recommendation-service version:v1.7` and finish final 40%->100% jump with same gates.

Priya: also add a short-circuit fallback: if quality regresses, route traffic to fallback-model-id=fallback-v1 via router rule. command: `/router set fallback rec-route->fallback-v1 job=72100`

Jordan: deploy-bot status: job 72100 -> pinned on prod-us & prod-eu; canary slice 72100-C live. monitoring hooks enabled. ETA ramp start 21:35 UTC. :rocket:

deploy-bot: reminders scheduled: 21:10 preflight (migrations dry-run, tokenizers validated), 21:30 pin already applied, 21:35 ramp begins.

Priya: please ensure logs include `canary_job=72100` and `actor=rec-safety` fields. I'll post step updates.

Nina: docs copy: "During tokenizer_swap, recommendation-service pinned to v1.7. rec-safety flag to be rolled via staged canary. Contact @Priya for ramp approvals; @Jordan for aborts. Canary job 72100."

Omar: any blockers? if not we'll run tonight.

Priya: :thumbsup: I'm available for approvals.

Jordan: on-call for the window.

qa-bot: eval suite ready. will post first-pass results after 0.2% soak.

Nina: thanks team. I'll post final release note and postmortem template after completion.
